title: low status on xdrip
body:
this is for the authors. It's been an issue since a long time and I actually mentioned this in the past but nobody was able to give me an answer. When xdrip reaches the low area and display low even if levels after 5 or 10 minutes go up because of the intake of sugar and eventually other meters and readers display the correct levels xdrip doesn't muove from the lower level until you perform a calibration and you enter the new value which could be 90 100 then it restarts and it keeps reading again what's going on guys?

 @jo1st

comments.body:
@jo1st Are you still having this problem?  If yes, you can post in the xDrip facebook group.  You will get responses the same day.  

Otherwise, would you please close this issue?
